# Import checklist

**1 folders · 23 markups · 1 imports**

Before you start:
- onX **Premium or Elite** is required to import.
- Use the **Web Map** at webmap.onxmaps.com on a computer.
- Each numbered step is ONE import. Drag in **all** the files for that step together.

### 1. Edge Cases  (23 markups)

- [ ] My Content → **Import** → select **Edge_Cases_Waypoints.gpx, Edge_Cases_Tracks.gpx, Edge_Cases_Areas.gpx**
- [ ] Tick **“Import map data to a new folder”**
- [ ] Click **Import**
- [ ] The new folder appears at the top named `Import <today>`. **Rename it to:** `Edge Cases`

### Renamed for onX

These names had `! @ # $ % ^ * &` removed. Search onX for the new name.

- `[r1i1] ZZTEST Peak #3` → `[r1i1] ZZTEST Peak 3`  (Edge Cases)
- `[r1i1] ZZTEST Rock & Roll` → `[r1i1] ZZTEST Rock Roll`  (Edge Cases)
- `[r1i1] ZZTEST Wow!` → `[r1i1] ZZTEST Wow`  (Edge Cases)

### Notes longer than onX keeps on import (512 characters)

onX cut a longer imported note to 512 characters, and dropped a much longer one entirely. Shorten these, or paste the rest into onX after import.

- `[r1i1] ZZTEST note 513`: 513 characters  (Edge Cases)
- `[r1i1] ZZTEST note 600`: 600 characters  (Edge Cases)
- `[r1i1] ZZTEST note 1000`: 1000 characters  (Edge Cases)
- `[r1i1] ZZTEST note 3000`: 3000 characters  (Edge Cases)
- `[r1i1] ZZTEST line note 513`: 513 characters  (Edge Cases)
- `[r1i1] ZZTEST line note 3000`: 3000 characters  (Edge Cases)

---

When finished, My Content should show **1 folders** and **23 markups**.

If a folder is missing items, delete that folder and redo just its step.
